scope: Only explicit 2019-2021 annual gate contradictions retained in failed_experiments.md. Missing annual evidence is never inferred.

annotations.evidence: 可扩容子集年度样本仅为 2/2/1，2021 年唯一一笔亏损 44.80 元，无法证明跨年稳定。
annotations.interpretation: 强趋势总体盈利不等于剩余仓位可安全扩容。

annotations.evidence: BOLL 宽度上升在 2019-2020 较好，但 2021 年平均收益和胜率均落后于宽度未上升组。
annotations.interpretation: 波动扩张不是低位反转的通用确认。

annotations.evidence: 温和趋势中的振荡指标领先序列年度样本仅 2/3/2，2021 年该组亏损 218 元，且没有 MACD 领先对照组。
annotations.interpretation: 交叉先后次序缺少可比较样本。

annotations.evidence: Kaufman ER 上升组在 2019 年收益和胜率、2020 年胜率、2021 年收益分别未胜出。
annotations.interpretation: 价格路径效率方向没有跨年一致性。

annotations.evidence: 高组合依赖组 2019 和 2021 平均收益较低且 MAE 更差，但 2020 两笔交易平均收益高达 15.31%。
annotations.interpretation: 高相关既可能是拥挤，也可能是广泛强趋势。

annotations.evidence: 多数宽度确认在 2020 年未同时改善胜率，2021 年则由低宽度组在收益和胜率上明显反超。
annotations.interpretation: 低市场宽度在部分年份恰好代表早期领涨。
更快 MACD 增加短命交叉和路径敏感性。

annotations.evidence: 临近压力位组在 2019 年反而收益更高，2021 年虽收益略低但胜率更高，均未满足统一拦截门槛。
annotations.interpretation: 压力位附近既可能受阻，也可能处于有效起涨。

annotations.evidence: 过度延伸突破总共只有两笔：2019 一笔且仍盈利，2020 为零笔，无法建立跨年反追高规则。
annotations.interpretation: 方向看似合理，但样本不足以形成交易规则。

annotations.evidence: 份额正流入组在 2019、2020 的收益和胜率均不优于非正流入组，到 2021 才同时占优。
annotations.interpretation: ETF 份额方向的含义随市场状态变化。
四日窗口留下更多陈旧交叉。
等待改变了后续路径，却没有稳定改善成交价格。

annotations.evidence: 2020 年 23/29 笔改善且中位数 +9.52bp，但均值 -0.78bp；513500 在 2020-02-03 单笔恶化 119.45bp，显示失败由追价尾部主导。
annotations.interpretation: 固定被动等待具有小额频繁改善、少数大额追价损失的逆向选择。

annotations.evidence: Bullish novel re-expansion averaged -0.36% with a 51.35% directional win rate in 2021, versus +0.28% and 58.27% for active true crosses.
annotations.interpretation: Same-side renewed divergence weakened across the training years and did not provide a stable substitute for a mathematical cross.

annotations.evidence: One-entry-ATR break-even reduced annual return from 49.74% to 45.91% in 2020 and from 8.46% to 7.55% in 2021; aggregate win rate fell from 56.18% to 48.94%.
annotations.interpretation: The cost floor forced premature exits and disrupted later portfolio allocation more than it protected recovered initial risk.

annotations.evidence: The MACD-free/KDJ-only candidate reduced annual return from 35.84%/49.74%/8.46% to 10.21%/33.63%/-3.67% in 2019/2020/2021 and increased buys from 92 to 170.
annotations.interpretation: K/D-only ordinary exits reacted too quickly, while removing MACD score support weakened entry coherence; the combined path overtraded and cut trend persistence.

annotations.evidence: The MACD-fast-exit candidate reduced annual return from 35.84%/49.74%/8.46% to 23.68%/39.88%/5.05% in 2019/2020/2021; total return, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, win rate, and profit/loss ratio also worsened.
annotations.interpretation: A recent-window MACD death cross without structure or ADX confirmation exits recoverable pullbacks and truncates trends in every training regime.
